name: Aminata Diallo
action: Aminata pauses with one hand on her tools and looks down briefly before meeting Moussa’s eyes. “Thank you, Moussa. I’m honored. Will I be expected to stay late or help serve tea?”
reason: Aminata’s shoulders hurt and she still needs to study when she gets home, but she does not want to dismiss Moussa’s invitation lightly because he has covered for her before. She also remembers last year, when she stayed too long and had to walk home in the dark. Those concerns lead her to ask what the evening will require before deciding.
